note: Cass County IA zones unincorporated land (code Sec. 3 adopts an Official Zoning Map kept in the Auditor's office, not published as a service). County GIS page lists only parcels, subdivisions, boundaries, townships and sections; no zoning layer or REST endpoint. Schneider wfs host has only site addresses. City of Atlantic publishes its zoning map only as an image (Updated-Zoning-Map.webp). ArcGIS Hub/Online searches for Cass County zoning found no official service. No queryable public zoning district polygons found for the county or its cities.
